Name: Imagical's Moschops
Author: imagicalfantasy
Description:
[center][size=5][b]🦕 Imagical's Moschops 🦕[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Imagical's Moschops[/b] introduces a prehistoric yet lovable creature into Stardew Valley: the [i]Moschops[/i].
This mod adds much more than just a new animal — it expands your farm with unique variants, items, recipes, sounds, and even custom music!

[size=4][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]New Farm Animal[/b]: Raise your very own Moschops, an adorable prehistoric companion.
[*][b]Home[/b]: Moschops live in barn. They can also live in Dinosaur Cave from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30907]SNES Livestock Dinosaurs[/url]
[*] [b]Multiple Variants[/b]: Black, Brown, and Gray — each with baby and incubator sprites.
[*] [b]Custom Music[/b]: A fun and unique soundtrack that plays when Moschops are inside your barn. (Require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36940]Imagical Animal Them Music Framework[/url]) (Soundtrack is made with same instruments than vanilla songs)
[*] [b]Eggs & Incubation[/b]: Collect Moschops Eggs (regular and cracked) and hatch brand-new babies (in ostrich incubator, the mod can allow Marnie to sell one).
[*] [b]Harvesting & Loot[/b]: Moschops dig every day to uncover random mushrooms (except Purple Mushrooms for balance). You can also trim their claws once a week for additional resources.
[*] [b]Cooking Recipes & Husbandry Integration[/b]: New recipes featuring Moschops Meat and Moschops Fat, fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] Mod.
[*] [b]Multilingual Support[/b]: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Chinese, and Hungarian.
[*] [b]Fun Surprises[/b]: The Moschops come with playful quirks and hidden extras to discover.
[/list]
[size=4][b]📦 Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher.[/url]
[*]Make sure install all required mods.
[*] Install facultative requirements.
[*] Extract the folder [b][CP] Imagical Moschops[/b] into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.
[*] Launch the game and enjoy raising your Moschops!
[/list]
[size=4][b]✅ Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] Works with most mods that use Content Patcher. 
[*]Tested with a lot of popular mods like SVE and more without issues.
[*] Cooking recipes require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url].
[*] Fully localized with built-in i18n translations.
[/list]
[size=4][b]💡 Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] The Moschops is both prehistoric and adorable — a unique addition to any farm.
[*] Compatible alongside other animal or creature mods.
[*] Adds a deeper sense of immersion with custom music and sound effects.
[/list]
[size=4][b]🤝 Credits[/b][/size]
Special thanks to the Stardew Valley community and to all dinosaur and prehistoric creature lovers.
Moschops of this mod are inspired by Moschops from ARK and EVO.
Sound effects are made from ARK assets.
With [i]Imagical's Moschops[/i], your farm will never be the same again!
